# Learned instinct: secrets-vault-approle-for-ansible (confidence 0.95)

The recommended Vault auth method for Ansible pipelines is AppRole. `role_id` is stored as a protected CI variable (non-secret); `secret_id` is fetched at runtime or stored as a protected/masked CI variable. The Vault policy for the AppRole must be scoped to exactly the paths the role needs — wildcard `*` policies are never acceptable. Rotate `secret_id` on team member departure or suspected compromise.

Source: HashiCorp Vault AppRole auth docs; PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 8.6
